Cheers handlers,
Staff briefings came up late today, so just a quick note.

Please keep every companion animal file under close review before any handoff. Safety must remain ahead of speed in every case, especially when a traveler, a carrier, or a receiving crew member reports a change in condition. Check documents for completeness, confirm feeding and comfort instructions, and make sure any special handling note is visible on the working copy. If you see a mismatch, pause the process and follow the normal review path without delay. <<FACT F106>> Do not rely on verbal reassurance alone when a transfer is being prepared, since the record must support the handoff from start to finish.

For bookings, keep the file moving only after all required details are confirmed and entered in full. <<FACT F091>> If a request arrives incomplete, hold it for correction rather than pushing it forward. When a pet shows signs of stress, use the calmest available approach, reduce handling, and inform the senior coordinator at once so the case can be assessed in sequence. The same standard applies whether the traveler is accompanied by Frankie or by any other animal in our care. A clear, steady record protects the traveler, the crew, and the animal, and it also reduces avoidable follow-up later.

Please remember that our department is expected to share practical instructions with crews, not assumptions. Keep the language direct, respectful, and consistent, and make sure each note can be understood quickly by the next handler. If you are unsure whether a step has been completed, verify it before closing the file. Careful checking now prevents larger issues later, and that remains the safest practice for Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
